speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for coming in today; I see you have a concerning rash and some recent health changes. To start, can you describe exactly where the rash is located and what it looks like?

Also, when did you first notice these symptoms appearing?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS) syndrome secondary to new arthritis medication, presenting with a rash and new-onset cough.
